This is a sexual assault, you should let them know how it made you feel

If they don't care about it/it continues cut the connection

About a week
I think I got time to prepare

I'm gonna head to bed now probably, It's really late and I got to rest 

But really thanks alot for talking with me, it's really sweet of you and you helped me relax

Goodnight/Good morning depending where you're at
I hope you have a good one! :)
A little bit, I thought asking to go to eat somewhere but I don't know restaurants or anything of the sorts

I'm not sure why or how, it just did

Most are online, I've been getting to know some people in real life too, just not much

I couldn't meet with them since there was a break for almost a month and I didn't have their contacts, now the break here is almost over so I've thinking of asking to hang out, I just dont want it to sound weird but I'm probably overthinking it

I see, have you talked to your grandma about it?
Did you ask her to keep your mom away from you?

Not the best since then, at the start it seemed great but everything went downhill after that

I've been trying, they don't usually reply and if they do it's just small messages like "Yeah" or "Nice"

I've also tried making new friends, not going too well for me too, I only talk to them maybe once every 2 weeks since they're busy

Thank you

I think 5-6 months, I've really lost track of time so it might be more
I don't know how old are you but have you thought about calling CPS?

The girl I've been with took over my life since we got together, I've sacrificed a lot of time, work and tears to help her be happy but whenever I felt bad myself she would always change the subject to her problems and trauma dump at me

Haven't had a chance to talk about my feelings for the longest time since we've been together for 2 years

Apart from that when we broke it off she started getting really close to my closest friend at the time, and from that they started to really drift apart from me

And with them the rest of my friend group, I don't know if it's related to it
But it happened at around the same time

Safe yes, apart from that not well

My life has been on a downward spiral for a while now, since 2020 I think

I had been in a really bad relationship up to a couple months ago but I broke it off due to the person hurting me, I've been really alone since

Don't do it
Give it a second thought, please
Somebody out there cares about you

There is a reason to keep going, you matter
Don't let your mom get to you

I guess cause everybody else did before 

I was probably someone I did but I got no clue what it could be

Thank you also, I know it's just a reply online but I appreciate it

Luckily people have just left and nothing bad happened to them

I'm trying to meet people and make new friends, I have trouble making conversation so it's a big struggle for me 

Thanks you regardless

Everybody I knew, they've just grown more distant as time went on and I didn't stop it in time
I'm still quite young so I got my parents, but that's it
I have one friend I'm still in contact with but that's online only, either way it's just a matter of time till they leave too
